## About
Florida Cars Used Auto Parts sells used parts out of Medley. We focus on late model vehicles, and Nissan is our specialty.
We keep an extensive inventory of used parts. Use our part search link to find what you need, or call and ask.
We're rated 4.7 from 81 Google reviews. One longtime customer says the staff inside and outside are amazing, which is very rare in this industry.

## Services
- Used parts: An extensive inventory of used parts for late model vehicles.
- Nissan parts: Our specialty. One reviewer said the Nissan part was exactly as described and came quickly.
- Late model Kia and Suzuki: We specialize in late model vehicles, including Kia and Suzuki.
- Part search: Look up the part you need online before you call.
- Local delivery: One reviewer used our local delivery and got a Nissan part without waiting on shipping.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday and closed on weekends.

Q: Do your parts come with a warranty?
A: Yes. We offer a 30-day standard warranty.

Q: How do I find out if you have my part?
A: Try the part search link on our site, or give us a call during business hours.
